_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Quality Management System (QMS)
summary: The Quality Management System (QMS) DID provides the roadmap and content preparation instructions for the complete QMS product required to be delivered under contract.
use_relationship:
The Quality Management System (QMS) provides the roadmap for the complete QMS to be implemented.
This data item description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The QMS shall be in contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The QMS shall contain the following parts:

children.title: Subpart 1. CTTR QMS Quality Manual.
children.content: This part shall include a QMS Quality Manual that is based on the existing QMS Manual and is in accordance with ISO 9001:2015. It shall also contain the following:

children.title: Any changes that enhance the existing QMS Manual
Subpart 2. Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) Timetable.
children.content: This part shall contain the following:

children.title: Details for the completion of all documents that are needed to implement the updated QMS and proposed changes.
A timetable for the development and implementation of all plans, procedures, work Instructions, Job Qualification Standards (JQSs), Tier IV, and records to be added or modified.
It shall also specify the following:
The document names, document number, site, and estimated dates of completion.
The timeline by quarters and the documents scheduled for development, verification, validation, and completion during each quarter.
Completion of all documents by the end of the first year of the contract.
